title: TRACE: Topological Representations for Anomaly detection through Contrastive Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.21548v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intrusion detectors must recognize evolving malicious behavior even when confirmed attack labels are scarce or incomplete. We present TRACE, a topology-aware graph contrastive learning framework for label-efficient intrusion detection. TRACE learns from benign system-activity graphs by combining message-passing and topological representations, then assigns anomaly scores in the same projected embedding space optimized by the contrastive objective. This design captures both local interactions and graph-scale structural deviations without using attack labels during representation learning. A labeled validation set containing benign and malicious graphs is used only to calibrate the anomaly threshold. We evaluate TRACE on StreamSpot, GraSec-IoT, and Unicorn Wget against a supervised graph neural network and the benign-only GraphCL baseline. translated_title: TRACE：通过对比嵌入实现异常检测的拓扑表示方法
translated_abstract: 入侵检测器必须在确认攻击标签稀缺或不完整的情况下，仍能识别不断演变的恶意行为。我们提出了TRACE，一个面向标签高效入侵检测的拓扑感知图对比学习框架。TRACE通过结合消息传递与拓扑表示，从良性系统活动图中进行学习，然后在由对比目标优化的同一投影嵌入空间中为样本分配异常分数。这种设计在表示学习过程中无需使用攻击标签，即可同时捕获局部交互和图尺度的结构偏差。一个包含良性和恶意图的带标签验证集仅用于校准异常阈值。我们在StreamSpot、GraSec-IoT和Unicorn Wget数据集上，将TRACE与监督式图神经网络以及仅使用良性数据的GraphCL基线进行了对比评估。TRACE分别取得了0.923、0.790和0.583的F1分数。与GraphCL相比，这一结果（原文此处截断）……
tldr: TRACE是一个拓扑感知的图对比学习入侵检测框架，仅利用良性系统活动图学习表示、无需攻击标签即可检测异常，在三个数据集上分别取得0.923、0.790和0.583的F1分数，显著优于仅使用良性数据的GraphCL基线。
en_tdlr: TRACE is a topology-aware graph contrastive learning framework for label-efficient intrusion detection that learns representations solely from benign system-activity graphs, achieving F1 scores of 0.923, 0.790, and 0.583 on StreamSpot, GraSec-IoT, and Unicorn Wget respectively without using any attack labels.
